blocks.raw: # Configure LINE Settings
blocks.text: Configure LINE Settings

blocks.raw: # Prerequisites
blocks.text: Prerequisites

blocks.raw: Before integrating LINE into Capillary, ensure the following prerequisites are met:
blocks.text: Before integrating LINE into Capillary, ensure the following prerequisites are met:

blocks.raw:
* [ ] **[Create a LINE account](#creating-a-line-account):** A LINE account is the primary account used to login to the LINE Developer Platform.
* [ ] **[Create a LINE Developer Platform Account](#creating-a-line-developer-platform-account):** The LINE Developer Platform is the portal to connect and utilize the LINE API.
* [ ] **[Create a Provider](#creating-a-provider):** A provider is an individual developer or organization that provides services and acquires user information on the LINE Developers platform.
* [ ] **[Create a Channel](#creating-a-channel):** A channel is a communication path for providers to use the LINE platform's features.
* [ ] **[Create a Bot](#creating-a-bot):** A bot allows you to send messages to users and leverage features such as rich menus and quick replies.
* [ ] **[Create a Webhook](#creating-a-webhook):** A webhook allows you to receive real time information from LINE.
* [ ] **[Configure the LINE Message API](#configuring-the-line-message-api):** The Messaging API lets you develop two-way communication between your service and LINE users.
* [ ] **[Channel ID and Secret Keys](#channel-id-and-channel-secret-keys):** The Channel ID and Secret Keys are identifiers used when integrating your LINE account with Capillary.

blocks.raw: ## Configuring the line message api
blocks.text: Configuring the line message api

blocks.raw: To connect your LINE account with Capillary, you need to enable the Messaging API for your account.
blocks.text: To connect your LINE account with Capillary, you need to enable the Messaging API for your account.

blocks.raw: Follow these steps to enable Messaging API:
blocks.text: Follow these steps to enable Messaging API:

blocks.raw:
1. Log in to your LINE developer account and select your target account.
2. Click **Settings**in the top right and go to the settings screen.
3. Select **Messaging API**from the menu on the left.
4. Click on the **Enable Messaging API**button.

blocks.raw: ## Creating a line gateway
blocks.text: Creating a line gateway

blocks.raw: Creating a LINE Gateway is required for managing message delivery through the LINE channel
blocks.text: Creating a LINE Gateway is required for managing message delivery through the LINE channel

blocks.raw: To create a LINE gateway on InTouch, follow these steps:
blocks.text: To create a LINE gateway on InTouch, follow these steps:

blocks.raw:
1. Login to InTouch and navigate to the [Gateways](https://incrm.cc.capillarytech.com/org/gateways/Gateways) page.
2. Under Gateway Settings, choose **LINE** from the Gateway drop-down menu.
3. Define the Gateway Weight (the ratio in which messages will be delivered).
4. Define the Start and End Time.
5. Click on **Submit**to create a LINE Gateway.

blocks.raw: To set up a webhook on the LINE developer platform, follow these steps:

1. **Configure the Webhook**
[Setup the webhook URL](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/messaging-api/building-bot/#setting-webhook-url) for the specific LINE channel.
